---
title: "Alaska — 2027 draw"
description: "Free estimated draw odds for every Alaska 2027 drawing permit hunt."
execute:
  echo: false
code-copy: false
---

Applications close December 15, 2026, at 5 p.m. Alaska time, at [hunt.alaska.gov](https://hunt.alaska.gov). Results are posted February 19, 2027.

[Odds as of November 24, 2026.]{.muted}

The chance of drawing is our estimate for one application in the 2027 drawing. A Low Confidence note marks a hunt where that estimate is less certain, because few people apply or the hunt or its rules are new.

::: {.sdo-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof species = Inputs.select(["All", ...speciesList], {label: "Species", value: "All"})
viewof query = Inputs.text({label: "Search", placeholder: "Hunt number, unit or area"})
```

:::

::: {.sdo-count role="status"}

```{ojs}
shown.length > 0
  ? html`<p>Showing ${shown.length} of ${hunts.length} hunts.</p>`
  : html`<p>No hunts match. Try a shorter search or set Species to All.</p>`
```

:::

```{ojs}
huntTable(shown)
```

::: {.sdo-download}

Hunt details are summarized from ADF&G's 2027-2028 Drawing Permit Hunt Supplement. Check the supplement before you apply.

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// The table as published, one row per hunt. The CSV starts with a byte-order
// mark so Excel shows dashes and apostrophes; strip it from the first header
// in case the browser hasn't.
hunts = {
  const raw = await FileAttachment("data/alaska_2027.csv").csv();
  const rows = raw.map(d => Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(d).map(([k, v]) => [k.replace(/^﻿/, ""), v])
  ));
  // Default order: species, then hunt number
  return rows.sort((a, b) => cmp(a.Species, b.Species) || cmp(a.Hunt, b.Hunt));
}

speciesList = [...new Set(hunts.map(d => d.Species))].sort(cmp)

// Species filter, then a search of hunt number, unit and area
shown = {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  return hunts.filter(d =>
    (species === "All" || d.Species === species) &&
    (q === "" || [d.Hunt, d.Unit, d.Area].some(v => v.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
  );
}

// Columns in display order. Chance of drawing and Permits sort by their
// numbers; "under 0.1%" sorts below 0.1%.
columns = [
  {key: "Hunt", rowHeader: true},
  {key: "Species"},
  {key: "Unit"},
  {key: "Chance of drawing", num: true, value: s => {
    const n = parseFloat(s.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""));
    return /^under/i.test(s) ? n / 2 : n;
  }},
  {key: "Notes"},
  {key: "Area"},
  {key: "Season"},
  {key: "Legal animal"},
  {key: "Who can apply"},
  {key: "Restrictions"},
  {key: "Permits", num: true, value: s => parseFloat(s.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))}
]

cmp = (a, b) => a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0

// The column the reader last sorted by. It lives outside the table so it
// survives a change of filter.
sortState = ({key: null, dir: 1})

huntTable = rows => {
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "sdo-table-wrap";
  wrap.tabIndex = 0;
  wrap.setAttribute("role", "region");
  wrap.setAttribute("aria-label", "Alaska 2027 drawing permit hunts");

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.className = "sdo-table";
  const headRow = table.createTHead().insertRow();
  const body = table.createTBody();

  const heads = columns.map(c => {
    const th = document.createElement("th");
    th.scope = "col";
    th.className = "col-" + c.key.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, "-");
    if (c.num) th.classList.add("num");
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = c.key;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (sortState.key === c.key) sortState.dir = -sortState.dir;
      else Object.assign(sortState, {key: c.key, dir: 1});
      draw();
    });
    th.append(button);
    headRow.append(th);
    return th;
  });

  function sorted() {
    const c = columns.find(c => c.key === sortState.key);
    if (!c) return rows;
    const v = c.value ?? (s => s.toLowerCase());
    // Ties keep the default order (species, then hunt number)
    return rows
      .map((d, i) => ({d, i, v: v(d[c.key])}))
      .sort((a, b) => sortState.dir * cmp(a.v, b.v) || a.i - b.i)
      .map(x => x.d);
  }

  function draw() {
    heads.forEach((th, i) => {
      if (columns[i].key === sortState.key) {
        th.setAttribute("aria-sort", sortState.dir > 0 ? "ascending" : "descending");
      } else {
        th.removeAttribute("aria-sort");
      }
    });
    body.replaceChildren(...sorted().map(d => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      columns.forEach((c, i) => {
        const cell = document.createElement(c.rowHeader ? "th" : "td");
        if (c.rowHeader) cell.scope = "row";
        cell.className = heads[i].className;
        // Let "Brown/grizzly bear" and similar wrap after the slash
        const parts = d[c.key].split("/");
        parts.forEach((p, j) => {
          if (j > 0) cell.append(document.createElement("wbr"));
          cell.append(j < parts.length - 1 ? p + "/" : p);
        });
        tr.append(cell);
      });
      return tr;
    }));
  }

  draw();
  wrap.hidden = rows.length === 0;
  wrap.append(table);
  return wrap;
}
```
